ui.updateTitle: A new version of VerseForge is available
ui.mainOnlyTitle: Hide LODs, decals, physics proxies and ship interior pieces
ui.emptyHint: Search on the left, then drag to orbit · scroll to zoom · right-drag to pan
ui.texTitle: Game textures (colour and normal map). Turn off to see only the material colours
ui.screensTitle: Screens of cockpits, dashboards and weapons (lit as if switched on)
ui.fullTitle: Mount the factory loadout: landing gear, weapons, thrusters, seats and components
ui.interiorsTitle: Load the interior: rooms, corridors and props of the ship's object containers
ui.sectionTitle: Section: slice the ship from above to look into the decks
ui.decksTitle: Decks found in the ship: show one, with everything above it taken away
ui.roomsTitle: Rooms of the ship, as the game defines them: show one alone (Ctrl-click to add more)
ui.lightTitle: Lighting: game-like hangar (on) or plain white studio (off)
ui.backdropTitle: Backdrop: plain, space from the game (Pyro, Stanton), modelling workbench or photo studio
ui.resinTitle: Show the model as a resin 3D print: one colour, no paint or decals, layer lines up close
ui.glbTitle: Binary glTF with materials and textures (Blender, Windows 3D Viewer, most 3D apps…)
ui.objTitle: OBJ + MTL + textures in a zip
ui.stlTitle: Raw STL in millimetres, game surfaces as they are
ui.expPoseTitle: Exports and 3D prints freeze the model as you see it: landing gear down, ramp open, any animation paused where you left it. A GLB with its animations keeps the rest pose
ui.printHint: A solid, watertight STL in millimetres, ready for the slicer. Runs Blender in the background; large models can take a few minutes.
ui.decalHint: The ship's markings (text, numbers, emblems, livery) at kit scale, for water-slide decal paper. Two PDFs at 600 dpi: one for clear paper with its white mask, one for white paper on the hull colour.
ui.matHint: Click a material to hide it.
ui.langNote: Translations may contain mistakes: tell us with Feedback.
ui.namesEnglish: English, as in the game's original
ui.namesNote: In another language, what the game has not translated stays in English. The search finds both names.
ui.cfgUpdates: Check for new versions at startup
ui.cfgCacheTitle: Models and textures already opened are kept on disk and open again much faster
ui.cfgCache: Keep opened models and textures on disk
